# Eye To Ad Media (eyetoad.com)

> Denver SEO agency, founder-led since 2012. Search engine optimization, local SEO and Google Maps, AI search visibility (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), generative engine optimization, conversion optimization, custom website design and AI chatbots for small and mid-size businesses. Office: 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204. Phone: 1-800-481-8638. Email: info@eyetoad.com. 5.0 average from 60 Google reviews; A+ BBB accredited.

## Facts
- Founded 2012 in Denver, Colorado by Zachary Tye Wennstedt (former sales manager for multi-million-dollar plumbing and remodeling companies).
- Primary market: Denver metro; also serves Boulder, Colorado Springs, Fort Collins, the Mountain West and national clients.
- Pricing: campaigns customized to budget and goals, most between $500 and $3,000 per month; $100 entry option; VIP Marketing Subscription $79.99/month ($69.99/month billed annually) for member pricing.
- No rankings, traffic or results are ever guaranteed.
- Proof: the founder's own company holds multiple listings on one Google results page for "denver walk in tubs" and is named by AI assistants on national accessible-bathing terms (see the Aging Safely Baths case study).
- Updated: 2026-09-21
